prompt_en: A complex clothing photograph in a small ceramics studio: an adult woman with face and hair appearance guided by the supplied reference is placing a wooden board of unfired bowls onto a timber worktable. Her garment features remain readable together during the working moment. Her short dark bob and a softly concentrated expression give the everyday scene a quiet personal appeal. She wears an ochre cable-knit Henley pullover with a collarless round neck and three buttons at center chest, its top button open. On this ochre pullover the short button placket begins at the neckline and stops within the front bodice, while on each shoulder a diagonal sleeve seam visibly continues from neckline to underarm. A cream jersey undershirt neckline is visible inside that opening, beneath the ochre outer knit. The front panel carries raised cable-knit braids crossing along the sweater, and fine parallel rib-knit bands finish the cuffs and lower hem. Charcoal drawstring cargo trousers have a front-waist casing holding a drawstring emerging from two waistband openings and tied into a loose bow; each thigh carries a separate flap-topped patch pocket with a visible expanding side gusset. Only the pullover's left front hem is caught inside the trouser waistband; its right front hem hangs free below the waist. The board is on her right side, with its near edge already resting on the tabletop while her two hands still support its outer corners from underneath. Both elbows connect visibly to the sweater sleeves; her boots are planted apart on the floor and her torso inclines slightly toward the table. Observe her from a three-quarter front view on her left, showing the whole figure from head to boots, with the working board to the side of her waist. Warm low window light rakes across the knit relief and the matte clay, casting a soft contact shadow under the board's resting edge. Keep natural skin texture and the clothing construction sharply readable, with soft shelves receding behind her.
